app_description:
# App Store Editors' Choice
How to turn your mobile into a professional camera in a blink? We did something cool.

Applying advanced computational photography and artificial intelligence algorithms, ReLens can instantly turn your phone into a DSLR professional camera.
With its powerful DSLR-grade large aperture that creates blur background bokeh effect and its 4K Ultra HD camera, ReLens camera portrait mode makes it easy to capture "DSLR-like" and "cinematic" shots. 

ReLens is designed to be a professional camera photography app for mobile photography enthusiasts and to help everyone enjoy the fun of photography easily.

# Excellent features

● F1.4-F20.0 aperture adjustment range, combined with background bokeh effect, say goodbye to simple and dull Gaussian Blur.

● Reproduction of several classic SLR lenses, such as the 50mm 1.4 fixed focal length lens, Burn 35, and the Swirly bokeh effect lens.

● AI recalculates the depth of field and adds realistic portrait camera bokeh effects.

● Freely modify the depth of field information of the image with the depth brush.

● Abundant professional photography watermarks and artistic photo frames to make your work show off your charm.

● Various professional camera lens optical effects include eclipse, Smooth Trans Focus, out-of-focus reflex, out-of-focus rotation, lens distortions, color shift, etc.

● Simulation of shutter blade shapes, over twenty realistic focus camera bokeh shapes such as the pentagram, hexagon, octagon, heart, etc.
 
● Reproduction of the unique spots, textures, and light effects of classic lenses.

● Intelligent partitioning for you to adjust different depth-of-field layers. You can tone the foreground, background, or sky without impacting the rest of the image.

● Professional photo editor: specialized color toning tools, such as Posterization, Curves, and HSL.

● AI HDR brightness algorithm analyses the photo scene and applies 5 different brightness fix modes: ultra-low light mode, slightly low light mode, normal low light mode, normal light mode, and backlight mode.

● Ultra-HD restoration enhances image quality comparable to that of a DSLR.

● Using high-speed machine learning algorithms for devices with Apple's chips, including the latest Metal, CoreML, and Apple Neural Engine (ANE)

● Privacy protection: Image processing runs locally on your device and does not upload your images to the server.



# All-Purpose Professional Camera Photography App
 
● Multiple camera modes: manual, auto, aperture (portrait), and self-timer.

● Camera custom color adjustment: White Balance Shift, Sharpening, Contrast, Saturation, Hue; built-in 6 commonly used presets such as Standard, Portrait, Neutral, etc.; dozens of classic cameras and master filters.

● Multiple image-quality options: Smart, De-sharpen, and High Quality. Disable the iPhone's auto-sharpening and auto-greyish.

● iPhone front and rear 20x magnification and a 136mm telephoto lens compared to a DSLR.

● Manual control of Exposure, Shutter, ISO, Focus, and White Balance.

● High-quality video recording, supporting 4K and 4K MAX video recording with up to 120 Mbps encoding rate and up to 240 FPS.

● Video Color Space: supports SDR, HDR10, and Dolby Vision. 

● Video stabilization: standard, cinematic, and extreme stabilization.

● Shoot ProRaw format and RAW format, and support shooting full-size HEIF or JPEG.

● Support for Single Autofocus (AF-S) and Continuous Autofocus (AF-C).

● SLR effect beauty: provides three modes: Clear, Natural, Cream, and Ruddy.

● Supports iPhone, iPad, and all other devices.

● Support setting the lock screen and home screen widget to open the camera quickly.
